capabilities: Turn a note or an existing checkbox note into a list
Reorder, select and act on items by drag and click
Attach Markdown notes and pictures to items
Tag, star, date and repeat items
Show dated items from all lists in a Schedule sidebar
extras: No network requests, data collection or account; clipboard is read or written only on request, and the Schedule enumerates the vault to find lists. A repeating item stays ticked in the file until it returns, so Tasks queries show it done meanwhile. On iOS a picture dropped from Photos may not reach Obsidian; paste it instead.
problem: Plain checkboxes in Obsidian cannot be dragged into order, carry their own Markdown notes, or be gathered by date across notes.

relations.evidence: Works with Tasks: dates use the Tasks plugin's format.

summary: Todo list plugin that turns Markdown notes into lists with heading sections, item notes, tags, dates and a schedule of dated items across lists.
